_band_kind: comparative evidence range, not a pass/fail criterion
_band_policy: Bands are read verbatim from the §9b comparative case table: every band is a Task-22 qualified-program ensemble evidence range, labelled 'comparative evidence range, not a pass/fail criterion'. No band is fitted to the engine output, widened, interpolated between cases, or replaced by a flat percentage.
_comparative_series_status: The ASHRAE 140-2023 Section 9.3 comparative test series is not implemented in this tree and is not implemented here: the CE cases are executed through the engine's §9 equipment dispatch and scored against the committed evidence ranges only.
_doc: Recorded ASHRAE 140-2023 Section 9b comparative execution results and per-case evidence-range rows (Issue #4666). GENERATED by the §9b harness (tests/validation/hvac_equipment_rated_performance/section9b_engine_run.rs) — re-record with FLUXION_SECTION9B_WRITE_RESULTS; never hand-edit.
_entering_condition_policy: The per-case entering wet-bulb is not transcribed for 13 of the 14 CE cases (the 140-2023 §9 input specification is licensed, #4285). The harness dispatches every case at every entering wet-bulb column the map tabulates and reports the envelope; it does not attribute a column to a case.

_metric_mapping.annual_cooling: not reproducible: needs the normative TMY2 weather file (licensed, never committed); a steady-state dispatch has no duty cycle.
_metric_mapping.max_zone_temp: not reproducible: needs the annual zone-temperature trajectory; the steady-state dispatch holds the case setpoint.
_metric_mapping.peak_cooling: scored against the engine's full-load cooling power at the case condition (compressor power + 230 W indoor fan, adjusted-net basis). The ensemble semantics (peak cooling load vs peak cooling power) are unverified (bounds CSV source_page = pending).

_no_pass_fail_criterion: Standard 140 defines no pass/fail criterion for the Task-22 comparative ranges. The 'pass'/'known_fail' status of a row means inside/outside the evidence range, never a verdict against the standard.

_status_legend.known_fail: the engine value falls outside the comparative evidence range — recorded with the real numbers, never omitted
_status_legend.no_band: no comparative band exists for that metric/case; the §9b table's explicit missing-band note is carried verbatim
_status_legend.not_reproducible: the band metric cannot be produced by this run (coverage gap)
_status_legend.pass: the engine value falls inside the comparative evidence range
